description: Call when you need a researched written brief on a topic (not instant). Delivered within 24h, usually same day: ~500 words default (max_words 50-1500), at least 3 cited public source links. Returns job id + dueBy now; poll GET /v1/jobs/:id (free) for result {title, summary, body_markdown, sources, word_count}. Public web sources only. Price: $0.25 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.
name: brief
title: Brief ($0.25)
